fixes.explanation: Right, baker. The Teacher, the son of David and king in Jerusalem (Ecclesiastes 1:1), "…also taught the people knowledge…" (Ecclesiastes 12:9). He didn't keep it to himself, because the people were the ones taught. So False is the answer.

A half-out nail is how you rip a sleeve, baker. The text describes them as "…firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd." (Ecclesiastes 12:11). Firmly embedded is the picture here, so half out isn't the one.
